confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors triangulate from several aggregated Querétaro or Mexico sources (Citycost Oct 2026, Cuánto me cuesta Apr 2026, Jobicy May 2026, and older 2023 data), converted at roughly 18 MXN per USD as implied by those sources. The midrange meal has the widest spread. No Querétaro-specific cocktail or wine prices were found, so both are set from the local beer relationship and are low confidence. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge with no live listing check. The FX value comes from search results citing the RBA overview page; the F11.1 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Querétaro-specific and Mexico-level aggregated price data, adjusted for Querétaro being a smaller and lower-cost city than Mexico City. Cocktail and wine are priced as multiples of the local draft beer anchor. Accommodation is benchmarked to general knowledge of mid-sized Mexican city hotels and hostels.
